name: ate_chart
description: Build a chart for the user (read-only; the app draws it inline). kind: price = HSKSwap pool candles from on-chain Swap logs; cex = HashKey Global klines; oracle = Supra (vault oracle) vs APRO vs pool; spread = pool vs CEX gap in bps with the round-trip cost line; depth = price impact in bps for a ladder of trade sizes (live QuoterV2, both sides); volume = pool USD volume; pnl = the vault's realised + marked P&L curve; exposure = vault exposure vs its cap; budget = epoch budget spent vs cap. Indicators (EMA, SMA, VWAP, Bollinger, RSI, MACD, ATR) are computed server-side; add them only when the user asks. markers adds journal decisions (buys, sells, no-trades). network=mainnet reads HashKey Chain mainnet market data even when the vaults run on testnet. Call when the user asks to see, chart, graph or plot something.

markers.description: Show journal decisions on the chart (default true for price and pnl)

network.description: vault = the daemon's chain (default); mainnet = HashKey Chain 177 market data
